images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create exactly ONE 1254×1254 PNG sprite animation sheet, four 627×627 square cells in a 2×2 arrangement, row-major, no borders, labels or gutters. Flat pure #00ff00 background throughout, opaque, no matting, no floor shadows. Image 1 is the APPROVED IDENTITY MASTER, rest pose direction S: preserve this exact young woman, face and proportions; dark curly hair tied back; ivory shirt; navy sleeveless tabard with plain chest; one diagonal chestnut harness to an olive canvas satchel on her anatomical LEFT hip (screen right); one belt; laced bracers; navy trousers; chestnut boots; a plain walnut staff with brass ferrules in her anatomical RIGHT hand (screen left); no insignia anywhere. Preserve costume construction and materials exactly. Painted 2D illustrated high-resolution finish, clean material planes, restrained surface texture, readable small silhouettes, no conspicuous brush or square grain. Keepers of Hours palette blue / ivory / brass. Single key light from SCREEN UPPER-LEFT fixed in all four frames; deep cool low-value ambient with readable shadows never pure black, slight rim on key-facing silhouette edge; no spell light or other warm/saturated illumination. Camera: fixed elevated three-quarter projection C, direction S toward camera. Same camera in all cells, no mirroring, no zoom, character stays centered in each cell and walks IN PLACE without translating across cell. Exactly identical anatomical scale and head size across cells; same baseline and root placement in all cells, allowing only natural gait vertical bob. Full body, all hair, boots, satchel and entire staff within each cell with comfortable green margin. Sheet intended for later uniform downscale and translation into 512×512 frames at feet pivot (256,400), S-idle height about 240 px; do not register or matte now. TOP LEFT frame 0 CONTACT: anatomical right foot (screen left) forward planted, left foot back. TOP RIGHT frame 1 RECOIL: weight settling onto right foot, knees bend, body lowest. BOTTOM LEFT frame 2 PASSING: left leg swings past supporting right leg, body rising. BOTTOM RIGHT frame 3 HIGH POINT: left foot forward about to plant, body highest. These are four consecutive frames 0–3 of an eight-frame walk cycle, visibly distinct gait phases. Arms swing naturally opposite legs. Staff stays upright in RIGHT hand and moves with that arm; satchel sways slightly on LEFT hip; tied curly hair mass moves a little. No added objects, environment, ground, text, insignia or ornament. Deliver only this one sheet.

references.role: APPROVED IDENTITY MASTER — rest pose, direction S; identity, costume, materials, register

concerns: Gait sequence differs from the requested phases: frame 0 appears left-foot-forward, frame 2 does not clearly show left-leg passing, and frame 3 appears right-foot-forward.
Exact baseline, scale consistency, pure-green plate values and projection-C constants were not quantitatively verified.
No retry: the sheet is 2×2, figures remain within their cells, and staffs stay in the anatomical right hand.
